outreach_message.subject: Windmill Labs - GitHub Actions Safety Baseline Report (EUR 99)
outreach_message.body:
Hello Windmill Team,

Thank you for your interest in the Revenue V1 GitHub Actions Safety Baseline Report. We have completed our read-only, immutable-SHA inspection (SHA: 796b6e5297d8cceb842ec097f33ec1c3115058bd).

Our deterministic repository inspection analyzed your workflows and identified areas for potential security hardening (e.g., missing permissions blocks and timeout-minutes).

To unlock the full detailed report, the price is fixed at €99.
If you'd like the complete audit payload delivered, please reply 'AUDIT' and we will process the payment.

Best regards,
Courier Commercial Engineering
